description.value:
Frequency once per day

You create an aura of absolute despair around you, causing your enemies to struggle against their lamentations. For 1 minute, each enemy entering or beginning their turn within 30 feet of you must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the greater of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The enemy is unaffected.

Success The enemy is unable to use reactions until the start of their next turn.

Failure As success, and they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure As success, and they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.
